name: Run Starlark Script (HTTP)
description: Execute a Starlark script that can call HTTP APIs via `http(method, url, headers={}, body=None, credential=NAME)`. Credentials are injected host-side from the module configuration and never exposed to the script; every request must name a credential whose policy allowlists the target host. Return data / stop() / output(name, data) as with the other Starlark actions.

script.title: Script
script.description: Starlark script defining `def main(arguments): ...`. Call http(method, url, headers, body, credential) to reach an allowlisted API; return data (or output(name, data) / stop()).

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Input object passed to the script as `arguments` (typically wired from previous playbook nodes).

outputs.default: Carries the returned results to the next node (withheld when the script returns stop()).
